title: M83: The Southern Pinwheel
explanation:
# M83: The Southern Pinwheel Galaxy

Imagine a cosmic pinwheel 40,000 light-years across spinning 12 million light-years away, its elegant spiral arms outlined by dark dust and brilliant blue star clusters, while ruby-red regions of newborn stars sprinkle its edges like jewels. Deep within this "Southern Pinwheel" galaxy lies an intense core seething with neutron stars and black holes—the violent remnants of a stellar baby boom that still blazes at X-ray wavelengths today.
